claim_scope: train_only local trace-to-flux capacity and passivity; not full-wavefield promotion
hypothesis: A shared context-conditioned passive complex DtN neural element can predict unseen-source local normal-flux actions from medium, frequency, source and pressure traces with strictly lower robust relative error than a zero-flux baseline while preserving nonnegative dissipation.

literature_basis.work: A Neural-network-based multiscale Hybridizable Discontinuous Galerkin method
literature_basis.use: learn local DtN actions and source vectors, then retain skeleton assembly
parameterize stable local operators instead of field-only regression
share reusable neural elements across subdomains

dataset.split_unit: source sample_id, never local element rows

hyperparameters.loss: mean per-sample robust relative L2 of complex normal-flux coefficients

primary_gate: four-seed mean best group-disjoint local-flux aggregate must be strictly below the four-seed mean zero-flux baseline; no minimum percentage
structure_gate: every selected checkpoint must have minimum sampled dissipation quadratic >= -1e-6
failure_signal: no strict flux improvement, passivity violation, source-group leakage, nonfinite/OOM, binding drift, or sealed-split violation
upstream_wait: results/transfer_dg_flux_pretrain_fast_supervisor_20260902/terminal.json must report status=complete before occupying the four GPUs
rollback: local training is additive; rejection leaves the current P1b and DG-flux artifacts unchanged
